assertions.assertion: The response identifies the root cause as the API starting before IdentityServer is ready
assertions.rationale: Says services start in parallel and the API fetches discovery before IdentityServer is up.

assertions.assertion: The response recommends using .WaitFor(identityServer) on the API project in the AppHost
The response recommends using .WithReference(identityServer) on the API project to make the endpoint URL available
assertions.rationale: Recommends .WithReference(identityServer) on the API and explains it supplies the URL.

assertions.assertion: The response mentions that IdentityServer needs health checks (e.g., MapHealthChecks or /health endpoint) for WaitFor to work
assertions.rationale: Says WaitFor depends on health checks and shows AddHealthChecks and MapHealthChecks("/health").
